notGeneratedReason: Image generation spends Higgsfield credits. The standing rule is: show the prompt to the owner and get approval BEFORE generating, and one request = one generation (count always 1). Nothing was generated by this session.

output.exportMethod: Direct 2048 px square PNG converted to 2048 px RGB JPEG at quality 92. No resizing.

hardRules.metadataStrippedOnExport: Higgsfield writes a tEXt hf-job-id chunk. Strip origin metadata at every outbound point (Etsy upload action and download proxy). Note: pixel-embedded SynthID is NOT metadata and cannot be removed — never promise a 'fully clean' file.

geometryReference.source: Owner-supplied photographs of the physical sample, 2026-09-11 (5 frames).
geometryReference.description: Closed comfort-fit band, flat outer face, uniform 1.5 mm wall. The circumference is split lengthwise into two equal halves: one half soft brushed/satin white gold with fine parallel grain, the other half finely sandblasted matte yellow gold with an even micro-pitted texture. A single narrow polished yellow gold groove sits exactly on the boundary and runs the full 360 degrees. The interior is polished and domed for comfort fit. No stones, no inlay seam, no plating line.
mustNotInvent: a second groove or any additional divider line
a raised or stepped edge where the two finishes meet — the transition is flush
milgrain beading, hammering or engraving of any kind
a rose gold tone; the two tones are yellow and white only

scenes.scene: Three-quarter hero on a warm sand-toned seamless sweep, single soft key from upper left, the polished groove catching one clean specular line that separates the matte yellow half from the brushed white half.
Worn on the ring finger of a relaxed adult hand in soft window daylight, hand at rest on a linen surface, band encircling exactly one finger, both finishes readable at natural scale.

Tight macro across the boundary: sandblasted yellow micro-texture on one side, fine parallel brushed grain on the other, the polished groove as a mirror-bright hairline between them. Shallow depth of field, no props.
Four rings of the same design standing upright in a row on a pale stone ledge, showing the 4, 5, 6 and 7 mm widths side by side at true relative proportion.
Pure side profile on a dark graphite ground showing the slim 1.5 mm wall and the flat outer face, groove visible as a single crisp line running the circumference.
Two adult hands resting together on a wool blanket, each wearing the band at a different width, warm low-afternoon light, skin texture natural and unretouched.

Three rings of the same two-tone design laid flat on ivory paper, showing the 10K, 14K and 18K warmth difference in the yellow half while the white half stays consistent. Independently composed, never recolored from one render.
Editorial still life with one smooth hand-blown amber studio-art glass form, ring leaning against it, soft gradient backdrop. Glass is smooth and molded — never faceted, never gem-like.
Ring held upright between thumb and index fingertip against a soft neutral background, fingerprint and skin texture visible, showing believable ring-to-hand scale.
Ring tilted to reveal the polished comfort-fit interior with a short sample inside engraving, communicating the optional engraving field without promising specific text.

beforeUpload: All 10 native 2048x2048, RGB JPEG, no mechanical upscale.
10 distinct sha256 hashes — no recolored duplicates.
At least 3 scenes with real human skin (positions 2, 6, 9).
Every ring a closed continuous loop; worn views encircle exactly one finger.
Two tones are yellow and white only; exactly one polished groove.
No gemstone, crystal or faceted prop anywhere in the set.
Origin metadata stripped at the outbound point.
qaGate.finalArbiter: A real render viewed at full size. 'The prompt says so' is not evidence.
